words.said: this is a self-organizing digital memory, where you can use WhatsApp to just send voice notes and ... it all organizes, self-organizes into your digital memory. And then you can connect all your agents via MCP ... you could have like personas that are kind of dispatched on your memory to look for like things that you should be reminded of or maybe look for ideas or look for possibilities you haven't thought of or maybe more therapy stuff or more like optimization ... And we should have all the landing page, really make sure that we have it up to date with all the latest and coolest way to explain stuff.
